phrases.text: This is everything in Fortnitemares right now, straight from Epic's own news and the official map.
Bosses, a cursed cartridge, a quest you can only unlock with friends, and exactly where to find all of it.
Let's get into it.
First, the big one. Epic's news tile is called The Horror Is Here.
A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches.
Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await,
including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more.
And that cartridge isn't just a story beat. There's a named spot on the map called the Dark Cartridge.
It sits right here, close to the middle of the island.
If you want to see the corruption for yourself, this is where to drop.
Next, Five Nights at Freddy's.
It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale,
with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor.
Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.
So where is it? Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria is a named spot on the map,
right here, in the northern part of the island.
That's the one place you know an animatronic boss will be.
And if you want to look the part, the Five Nights at Freddy's Bundle was in the Item Shop on October 28th:
Freddy Fazbear, Foxy the Pirate, Chica the Chicken and Bonnie the Rabbit,
for 4,500 V-Bucks, listed at 11,000.
Quick one: if you buy anything in the shop, use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel, and it keeps these videos coming.
Now, the community side of Fortnitemares. Epic's tile is called Horrors Worth Facing Together.
Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares!
Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist.
Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.
So that's a quest you can't do solo. Grab your squad before you jump into the Collection.
One more spot that fits the season: Nightmare Neighborhood is a named location on the map,
right here, north-west of the island's centre.
And all of this is happening on top of Override.
There are all new Sprites to discover and collect!
Extract and equip them for game-changing Sprite Powers, level them up, and keep growing the Collection in Override.
Sprites will now appear in Ranked too, with abilities disabled to maintain even competition.
And if you're hunting Override Consoles, there are seven of them on the map right now.
So, the quick recap.
The cursed cartridge is spreading, and the Dark Cartridge sits near the middle of the map.
One animatronic boss is always at Freddy Fazbear's, up north.
Safety in Numbers needs friends.
And Sprites are in Ranked, with their abilities turned off.
Which part of Fortnitemares are you playing first? Tell me in the comments.
And if this helped, use code BAD in the Item Shop. See you in the next one.
